diff --git a/scripts/release.py b/scripts/release.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..44fc343d4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/release.py
@@ -0,0 +1,38 @@
+"""Automate release preparation."""
+
+import argparse
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+def run_command(command: list[str]) -> None:
+    print(f"Running: {' '.join(command)}")
+    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=False)
+    if result.returncode != 0:
+        print(f"Command failed with exit code {result.returncode}")
+        sys.exit(result.returncode)
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Automate release preparation")
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--skip-tests",
+        action="store_true",
+        help="Skip running tests and linting",
+    )
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    # 1. Run tests and linting
+    if not args.skip_tests:
+        print("Running tests and linting...")
+        run_command(["./scripts/test.sh"])
+        run_command(["./scripts/lint.sh"])
+        run_command(["./scripts/format.sh"])
+
+    # 2. Update release notes date
+    print("Updating release notes date...")
+    run_command(["python3", "scripts/add_latest_release_date.py"])
+
+    print("Release preparation complete!")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
